TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place in view of “Kisan Panchayat” at Ram Leela Maidan on 19.03.2026 (Thursday).

-Traffic movement will be regulated/diverted in Central Delhi and commuters may experience congestion around Ram Leela Maidan and adjoining roads.

Time: 06:00 AM – 04:00 PM

📍 Diversions/restrictions on need basis at JLN Marg, Asaf Ali Road, Chaman Lal Marg, Ajmeri Gate, Minto Road, Delhi Gate & R/A Kamla Market.

📍 Avoid affected stretches, plan your journey in advance & use public transport wherever possible.

📍 Stay updated through Delhi Police Traffic channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
